components.name: Primary Button

components.name: Input
components.description: Inset field with visible label and violet focus border.
components.css: .ds-field { display:block; font:500 13px var(--font-sans); color:var(--color-ink-150); } .ds-input { display:block; margin-top:6px; width:100%; height:40px; border:1px solid var(--color-ink-600); border-radius:var(--radius-sm,8px); background:var(--color-ink-950); padding:0 12px; font:400 14px var(--font-sans); color:var(--color-fg); caret-color:var(--color-accent); transition:border-color 200ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:var(--color-ink-300); opacity:1; } .ds-input:hover { border-color:var(--color-ink-500); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color:var(--color-violet-400); outline:none; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity:.5; }

components.description: Compact text links with appearance-aware hover and focus.
components.html: ExploreThe experiencePasses
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:30px; font:500 14px var(--font-sans); color:var(--color-fg); } .ds-nav a { color:inherit; text-decoration:none; transition:color 160ms; padding:12px 0; } .ds-nav a:hover { color:var(--color-tone-violet-200); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-brand-hi); outline-offset:2px; border-radius:4px; }

components.name: Programme Filter
components.description: Neutral pill filter; selected state reverses foreground and canvas.
components.css: .ds-filters { display:flex; gap:4px; flex-wrap:wrap; } .ds-filters button { border:0; padding:10px 14px; border-radius:999px; font:400 13px var(--font-sans); color:var(--color-fg-muted); background:transparent; transition:background 150ms; } .ds-filters button[aria-pressed="true"] { background:var(--color-fg); color:var(--color-canvas); } .ds-filters button:hover:not([aria-pressed="true"]) { background:var(--color-surface); } .ds-filters button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-brand-hi); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Catalogue Lightbox
components.description: Dark media frame showing an explicit missing-artwork state.
components.html: No thumbnail
components.css: .ds-lightbox { position:relative; display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center; align-items:center; gap:8px; aspect-ratio:16/9; min-width:220px; background:#0b1122; color:#94a2be; border-radius:var(--radius-lg,16px); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(117 89 255 / .28),var(--shadow-e3); overflow:hidden; font:400 12px var(--font-sans); text-decoration:none; transition:transform 380ms var(--ease-marquee); } .ds-lightbox::after { content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none; box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgb(37 199 247 / .22); } .ds-lightbox:hover { transform:translateY(-4px); } .ds-lightbox:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-brand-hi); outline-offset:2px; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-lightbox:hover { transform:none; } }

components.name: Loading Film Frames
components.description: Supplied Skopia logo with a violet-and-cyan orbit during an actual pending request.
components.html: SKOPIALoading the programme…
components.css: .ds-loading { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:20px; padding:32px 0; font:500 13px var(--font-sans); color:var(--color-fg-subtle); } .ds-logo-loader { position:relative; display:grid; place-items:center; width:152px; height:152px; } .ds-orbit { position:absolute; inset:0; border:2px solid transparent; border-top-color:var(--color-violet-500); border-right-color:var(--color-cyan-400); border-radius:50%; animation:ds-orbit 2.4s linear infinite; } .ds-logo { display:grid; place-items:center; width:110px; height:101px; border-radius:14px; background:var(--color-inset); color:var(--color-fg); font:800 16px var(--font-marquee); animation:ds-breathe 2.4s var(--ease-house) infinite; } @keyframes ds-orbit { to { transform:rotate(360deg); } } @keyframes ds-breathe { 0%,100% { transform:scale(.97); opacity:.85; } 50% { transform:scale(1); opacity:1; } } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-orbit,.ds-logo { animation:none; } }

narrative.overview:
The Screening Room pairs a matte silver-lilac canvas and plum lettering with photographic screens, restrained violet actions, and dark media surfaces. Ink remains the dark appearance. The guest experience is spacious and cinematic; viewer and staff shells retain compact navigation, readable records, and the same typography and controls.

The binding Skopia name, supplied logo, tagline, four brand colors, and three self-hosted type families are retained. System appearance is the default; explicit Light and Dark preferences share one store and synchronize across controls, browser tabs, and live operating-system changes. Atmospheric mountain, city, and forest images are editorial brand art; they do not represent playable catalogue entries.
keyCharacteristics: Matte neutral surfaces with restrained violet actions.
Condensed Archivo headings, quiet Instrument Sans copy, JetBrains Mono data.
Dimensional photographic screens and darker media frames.
Compact work surfaces with explicit loading, empty, and failure states.

rules.name: The Two Grounds Rule
rules.body: Resolve interface surfaces and text through appearance tokens; media artwork and overlays retain their dark ground.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Use Archivo for headings, Instrument Sans for interface copy, and JetBrains Mono for references, timecodes, and measured data.

rules.name: The Offset Depth Rule
rules.body: Use the existing offset, softly blurred elevation vocabulary for lifted surfaces; inset sign rules belong to media frames.

dos: Do use the shared appearance store and semantic text tones in both modes.
Do use uploaded thumbnail URLs for catalogue media and show “No thumbnail” when absent or broken.
Do use published catalogue artwork for landing features and show missing media honestly.
Do retain visible focus, honest retry/empty/loading states, and viewport-bounded menus and dialogs.
Do preserve the pinned self-hosted fonts, supplied logo, and binding brand colors.
donts: Don’t present generated brand landscapes as catalogue titles or invented thumbnail artwork.
Don’t use raw dark-theme neutral values for interface copy on light surfaces.
Don’t turn a landing-page composition into a mandatory layout for staff consoles.
Don’t describe stale Figma mappings or planned backend behavior as shipped truth.
Don’t generalize approved hero lettering to every heading or introduce kickers above headings.
